text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The older girls running with me in the 
Sprinters Stakes are so strong and 
dependable...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was really worried... wondering if I 
could truly compete alongside them. But... 
Trainer gave me the push I needed!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Both Sakura Bakushin O-san and Yamanin 
Zephyr-san are full of energy, so they'll 
surely be tough opponents. But...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I have you by my side, Trainer! I'm going 
to show everyone that I can be the 
greatest sprinter on this "stage"!
